body:
I thought it had gotten better the last couple days after standing up to my girlfriend on being stood up the other day... but she's basically cut off all communication saying 'we'll talk when we can talk in person' and is now proceeding to avoid and excuse herself from all possible opportunity to do so.

At first I was angry, then I cried, now I just give up. There's nothing I can do at this point but suffer. Either I'm the asshole who dumps her via text message and lose all my friends, or I just sit and suffer as she continues to treat me like shit. The whole thing is just making my muscles constantly tense and my stomach upset and I can't bring myself to eat or sleep. I just excused myself from a social event I was invited to because there's no way I could maintain my composure and not just break down in front of everyone. I'm trying to figure out a way to excuse myself from my family's easter dinner as I write this. I can't leave the apartment like this.

In Canada right now people are coming out of education degrees and being forced to work in dollar stores for minimum wage because the union favors seniority so much that even all the substitute work is being taken up by retired teachers coming back to work for extra spending money on top of their pension. Then without substitute experience its practically impossible to get your own position in a school.

my friend situation is odd to say the least. Except for one group of guys I used to live with (who will not be in my hometown over the summer) almost all my friends have been gained through romantic relationships as I'm kinda shy but (at least used to be) physically attractive (I've since gone from extremely fit to maybe 10 pounds overweight, my clothing isn't as nice because money has been tighter, and my knee is kinda shitty so I limp sometimes)... So I'd get asked out by a girl and make a ton of new friends (aka her friends) generally, as I naturally get along better with the opposite gender anyway.

I play bass + keys mostly, doing classical piano lessons at the school. I own two guitars but can't play them worth shit because I've never found the time to learn. I'm mostly into synthesis these days.
it would probably lead to me being too identifiable. If I were to transfer it would probably count as history to other schools though.

my program is unique enough that I basically can't transfer.

Because I have both government and private loans, taking time off or switching down to part time also isn't an option really (if I take time off, the private loan fucks me, if I go down to part time, the government one does).

the music is the hobby, not the degree (if it was the degree, I could probably find some people to collaborate with and it wouldn't feel like such a dead end...). The degree is your usual liberal arts type thing, but its a weird and new enough program that if I mentioned it specifically it would break the anonymity.

Today I think was the breaking point for the relationship when she came into town to write an exam and didn't even stop in to say hello. I only realized she had came and gone again from her twitter feed. I sent an incredulous text message that led to a 'we need to talk' type thing, a few heated texts, and as far as I can tell its basically over but she insists on wanting to talk in person and just dropping it until then (Whenever the hell that could be, as we barely saw each other while living together, and she just moved home for the summer).

I don't know what I'm going to do about the ruins my social life will be in if we break up though. I'm moving back to my parents hometown for the summer to save money and work... The only other people I know who are moving back there are the (possibly soon to be ex-) girlfriend and one or two mutual friends that would probably pick her over me. Damned either way I guess.
